2. On due consideration and for the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is hereby allowed.
3. Delay of 18 days in filing the instant appeal, is hereby condoned.

4. This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellants-claimants challenging the award dated 28.03.2019 passed by the III Additional Member,
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Gwalior (M.P.), in Claim Case No. 1510/2017, seeking enhancement of compensation amount.

sentences.text: As per the impugned award, the Claims Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.11,92,187/- along with interest from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization on account of the death of Vijay @ Lala Bhadoriya in the motor accident.
7. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the learned Claims Tribunal failed to properly appreciate the settled principles of law and has awarded inadequate compensation.
It is contended that appellant Nos. 2 to 5, being the children and dependents of the deceased, have been wrongly denied compensation under the head of loss of consortium.

Placing reliance on the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of United India Insurance Company Ltd. vs. Satinder Kaur and Others (2020 ACJ 2131), it is submitted that the children of the deceased are also entitled to consortium.

entities.text: United India Insurance Company Ltd. vs. Satinder Kaur and Others (2020 ACJ 2131)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, it is prayed that a reasonable amount of compensation be awarded under the said head.
8. On the other hand, learned counsel for Insurance Company supported the impugned award and prayed for dismissal of appeal.

9. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the entire record of the Claims Tribunal.
10.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and upon perusal of the record, this Court finds force in the submissions advanced on behalf of the appellants.
In view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court i n United India Insurance Company Ltd. (supra), the children of the deceased are also entitled to compensation under the head of consortium.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:10865 3 MA-4048-2019
The learned Claims Tribunal committed an error in not awarding consortium to appellant Nos.2 to 5, who are the children and dependents of the deceased.
11. Accordingly, the misc. appeal is allowed in part .
The appellant Nos. 2 to 5 are held entitled to an additional amount of Rs.1,60,000/- (Rs. 40,000/- each) towards consortium.
Except for the aforesaid modification, the remaining part of the award passed by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
12. With the aforesaid modification, the miscellaneous appeal stands partly allowed and is accordingly disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE *VJ*
